sources: https://book.wvstateparks.com/Ecomm/Listings/SupplierTile/7816932/en-US?supplierId=7989212 (Seneca State Forest Non-electric Campsites; stays from 2026-11-03 to 2027-12-01 read 2026-10-21 with audit/state_park_fees/wv_tiles.py)

values.note: 'Before occupying any campsite, campers must have a paid reservation and all sites are reservable.' Reserve online, at 833-987-2757 or at the campground office; two nights at least on Friday-Saturday, one night Sunday-Thursday (the booking site refused a lone Saturday, 2027-06-19, and sold the same sites for Friday-Saturday). 14 consecutive nights at most.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-seneca-state-forest/ ('Before occupying any campsite, campers must have a paid reservation and all sites are reservable.', 'Reservations can be for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday – Saturday) or for one night on Sundays through Thursdays.', 'Reservations may be made online or by calling 833-987-2757.', 'Visitors can book a maximum of 14 consecutive nights.') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7989212 (2027-06-19 one night: none; 2027-06-18 two nights and 2027-06-15 one night: all 10 sites), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'The campground is open from spring through fall, weather permitting.' Dates are the booking site's: the first night it sells is April 1 (none on March 31 or any night from December 1 to March 30) and the last is November 30.

season.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-seneca-state-forest/ ('The campground is open from spring through fall, weather permitting.') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7989212 (sites offered 2027-04-01, 04-04, 04-05, 04-06, 2026-11-26, 11-29, 11-30; none 2027-03-31, 03-30, 03-09, 01-12, 01-16, 2026-12-01, 12-08), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 10 large, secluded sites with level tent and trailer pads. 'The maximum recommended length for RVs is 28 feet. Contact the forest office regarding larger units and adjacent sites.'

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-seneca-state-forest/ ('Seneca has 10 large and secluded campsites. The maximum recommended length for RVs is 28 feet.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Free showers and coin-operated laundry are at the forest office, not in the campground; the forest's lodging page also lists a bathhouse. Firewood for sale. No cell service in the area; Wi-Fi at the forest office.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-seneca-state-forest/ ('Coin-operated laundry machines and free showers are available at the forest office', 'Firewood is available for sale') + https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/lodging/ ('Laundry station', 'Bathhouse available') + https://wvstateparks.com/parks/seneca-state-forest/ ('Cell service is non-existent in the surrounding area. Wi-Fi is available at the forest office.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Camping page confirms the inherited booking rules into the entry and adds all-reservable (fcfs never) and the reservation phone; season spring-fall (booking calendar April 1 - November 30), no hookups, 10 sites to 28 ft, showers and laundry at the forest office written. Fees left as recorded (see flag).
flags: Fees (an earlier check, not overwritten): the entry's $29.99/$29.99 is the June/November price; the booking site charges $22.99 a night for April, May and August 2027 stays (2027-04-01, 04-20, 05-11, 08-10) and $29.99 for June and October 2027 and November 2026. Suggest nightly_low 22.99, nightly_high 29.99.
